title: Clarify conflict resolution normativity
description: Section 3 states JMAP writes take priority in conflicts (line 368-369) as if normative, but the spec only says enforcement is simulation-layer-defined. Mark this as recommended policy, not spec requirement.
close_reason: Fixed: reframed conflict resolution section to note spec does not prescribe conflict policy; changed 'Resolution: the JMAP write takes priority' to 'Recommended resolution'; added note that deployments may reverse priority for physics-controlled objects
